Stock & Pricing
Card view
💰 Auto Sell Range
Buy price ke hisaab se Sell Range automatically banega. Har price band ka markup set karein.
Existing filled ranges automatic overwrite nahi honge.
Card presentation & readability
Readable UI
Shop owner ki aankhon ke liye text, buttons aur UI ko thora bara karein. Ye setting Save changes ke baad permanently apply hogi.
💰 Amount display
Choose whether large amounts should use K (for example, 25K) or show the full number with commas (25,000). This changes display only; saved amounts remain unchanged.
📊 Dashboard reporting period
Dashboard par Sold aur Net Profit kis period ke hisaab se dikhana hai. Business month choose karein to har month isi din se naya cycle start hoga.
1–28 rakhein taake har month cycle reliably repeat ho.

Privacy & Security
Privacy mode
🗑️ Clear data password
Sirf “Clear data” action ko protect karta hai. Kam az kam 4 characters rakhein.
App Lock
🔒 App Lock
App khulte hi lock screen show hogi. Aap apna custom PIN, Pattern aur Fingerprint methods set kar sakte hain.
PIN aur Pattern aapke custom app credentials hain — phone ka screen-lock nahi.
Backup, Sync & Data
Cloud Sync
Account sync status loading…
Backup
Manual backup karein, ya app online hone par har 24 ghante baad automatic cloud backup le.
Auto cloud backup: har 24 ghante
Cloud Backup History & Restore
Cloud par backup banayein, saved backups dekhein, ya kisi date/time tak ki latest saved history restore karein. Is feature ke liye Firestore rules mein shop ke backup/history subcollections ki permission zaroori hai.
Cloud backup status check nahi hua.
Sync Conflicts
Agar ek hi entry mukhtalif devices par edit hui ho, sync rok kar dono versions dikhaye jayenge. Aap select karein ke kaunsa rakhna hai.
Import / Restore
Danger Zone
Clear data se app ka local business data remove ho jayega. Password protection apply hogi.
Data Management
Import / Restore
Danger Zone

Shop Access Management
Requests & access
Naye shops pehle Pending rahenge. Aap approve, reject, suspend aur baad mein reactivate kar sakte hain.
Editable notification messages
In messages mein {shopName}, {ownerName} aur {reason} variables use kar sakte hain. Ye text aap kabhi bhi change kar sakte hain.
About Mobile Hisab
Mobile Hisab by Z Mobile
An app for managing inventory, sales, expenses, reports, and cloud sync for a used mobile phone business.
